record_scope_reconstruction: Truck obstruction resumed toward Siret at noon on 15 January. Romanian police figures quoted by TVR show outward traffic resumed on 17 January, ten trucks hourly; entry to Romania remained blocked.

source_checks.finding: January 15 article identifies noon resumption of Siret freight obstruction.
TVR gives actual 17 January outward processing of 155 trucks from 10:00 and continued inbound blockade.

sites.name: Siret–Porubne
sites.coordinate_method: Independent inspection of preserved versioned OSM source metadata; no fresh OSM API retrieval claimed

sites.evidence_note: Preserved OSM node 3019220234 v3 anchors the Romanian road-control end; the Council land-border evaluation identifies Siret opposite Porubne on E85. The independent published crossing coordinates at umanmap.eu are within about 70 m. Actual protest machinery stretched along the approach, not necessarily at this pin.
